title: that dark matter video aged like milk
summary: Angela Collier, a physicist, revisits her earlier dark matter video, explaining dark matter as a set of observations rather than a theory and discussing MOND comments.
why: HN points to her videos as a counterpoint to popular dark matter discussion, framing it as the discrepancy that needs explaining.

quote.text: these YouTube videos are a nice counterpoint to a lot of popular communication and discussion on dark matter
